page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a Greek motto centred below the text; a woodcut ornament below the motto. No marginal notes. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.

main_text.p: quam recte monentem sequi. Homo enim sum, humani nihil à me alienum puto. Et quid? Etiam sæpe curæ, sæpe necessitas brevitatem observandi, sæpe etiam vigoris animi remissio effecerunt, ut non ubique, quod quidem præstare volui & potuissem, affecutus fuerim. Quicquid autem horum sit, libens errata corrigam, & cætera in melius mutabo, ubi rectius edoctus fuero. Et nunc jam adeo indictum esto: quicquid Scripturæ Sacræ, naturæ, bonis moribus, ac veræ Catholicæ Ecclesiæ confensui adversum in his libris forte inventum fuerit.

page.notes: The running head reads "INST. PHYS. LIB. XII." with the number 638 in italic at the left; the Greek motto is printed as "Μόνῳ Θεῷ Δόξα" in the scan, with accents uncertain. The woodcut ornament has no text. Faint marks at the left edge and foot are show-through or damage and are omitted.
